visual_identity.core_identity: An ambush creature that resembles a leathery stalactite-like mantle while clinging overhead until it peels away and drops.
visual_identity.silhouette: Flattened manta-like leathery body with broad mantle edges and several short dangling tentacles beneath.
visual_identity.head_features: Small central underside head or beak-like mouth largely hidden beneath the mantle, with simple predatory features.
visual_identity.body_shape: Compact central body under a wide flexible mantle, short gripping tentacles, no humanoid limbs.
visual_identity.surface: Leathery membrane with sparse folds and simple underside texture.

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

physical_requirements: overhead_attachment: ambush posture requires a believable overhead support; environment engine chooses the ceiling, rock, beam, branch, or other compatible support
